notes: Village of Hemingford, FY ended 9/30/2022. Governmental funds modified cash basis (General, Debt Service); business-type (Electric, Water, Sanitation, Sewer, Care Center) on the accrual basis, recorded as net position from the proprietary statement p7 (as in FY2023/FY2024); business-type expenses total 2,792,816 printed on the Statement of Activities p2. Taxes 464,023 (p5) split by the printed Statement of Activities general revenues breakdown (p3: Property 264,241, Motor vehicle 17,258, Sales tax 182,524; adds exactly). The fund schedules' tax lines do not tie to the statement's Taxes column (General Fund schedule tax/homestead/prorate lines 342,830 vs statement 342,334), so they were not used for the split. Miscellaneous 48,073 kept as one line (General 43,239 + Debt Service Keno 4,834). Grants 7,013 has no grantor printed: other / Grants. Capital outlay 129,804 on the statement has no single function: 'Capital Outlay'; the schedule's capital outlay lines take the department heading's function. Governmental roll-forward on fund balance (no single cash total printed; cash left null as in later years): 790,685 + 641,501 - 834,074 + 177,689 = 775,801. Business-type: 2,491,266 + 2,937,174 - 2,792,816 - 177,689 = 2,457,935 (receipts total = operating 2,852,040 + non-operating revenues 85,134; no single printed total). Care Center line of credit repayments 49,083 appear only on the cash flow statement. Proprietary cash flows (pp8-9) printed but left null as in the later years. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the p4 governmental funds Total column (equals the p1 governmental column 775,801), business-type lines and totals from p1. Detail: General Fund (department x object) and Debt Service Fund budget schedules; schedule lines with no actual amount ('-': Election expenses, Paid out to school, Advertising/Miscellaneous/Education and training/Uniforms and equipment/Grant purchases for police, Workmen's comp/Education/Advertising for library, etc., capital outlay in Streets/Parks/Pool) omitted. No budget schedules for the enterprise funds (no statement lines added for them, as in later years). Read pages 1-16 of 16
